Frontend /niche-markets: nm-velocity strip renders with 3 cards ('Closed last month · Closing now · Projected next'), Toro row shows warmth badge, opening Toro drawer (nm-open-NM-9FB40580) shows nm-margin-sim (breakeven text recomputes instantly when nm-sim-rate changes from 2000→2500; payback line 'Acquisition payback: 0.7 months at expected margin' visible when acq cost set) and nm-intel-panel (nm-intro-source/nm-warmth-input/nm-current-carrier/nm-switch-angle/nm-acq-cost all save via nm-intel-save and PERSIST verified after page reload). Bobcat drawer (NM-6FD05DD2): linked-carrier row for CN-49DE4F08 shows nm-link-rate-{pid} + nm-link-status-{pid} editors, changes PATCH successfully, nm-link-summary reflects 'signed/live count · avg locked rate · still to source'. Regression: AI Battle Card + AI Pitch buttons still present and rendered (existing Toro/Bobcat battle cards + pitches rendered in drawer without regeneration), stage select in table works, nm-followups-panel + readiness panels still render.

issues: ESC key still does not close nm-drawer — has to be dismissed via X or backdrop click.
Global 'MOSTLY LIVE · Real records exceed sample records' banner appears above Niche Markets H1 even though all 45 targets in this module are real (is_sample=false).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/niche_markets.py TargetPatch validates warmth_score 1-10 via Field but returns 422 (Pydantic) while other business errors return 400 — consistent enough, but frontend nm-warmth-input has no client-side min/max clamp so pasting '15' will silently 422 without user-visible error (toast). Recommend clamp in NicheMarkets.jsx saveIntel().

patch_target only records stage_history when prev.stage != patch.stage — good. However there is no cap on stage_history length; over years a target could accumulate hundreds of entries. Consider $push with $slice: -50 to bound.
LinkPatch does not validate that at least one of rate_usd/status is present when both are None (empty body returns 400 via 'Nothing to update' — verified). Fine as-is.

Dashboard velocity._moves iterates rows × stage_history in Python which is O(N*H). For 45 targets fine, but adding a persisted month index or precomputed velocity doc would scale better if the target list grows.
Frontend nm-intel-save PATCH sends all intel fields on every save even if unchanged — harmless but noisy. Could diff before sending.

Bobcat link-summary displayed 'avg locked rate $1,550' after my test set rate=1550 status=signed, then still showed $1,550 briefly during restore — restore PATCH did fire (verified via reopened drawer showing 1400/rate_agreed). Recommend the summary line pull directly from `links` state after PATCH response instead of local optimistic value to avoid brief stale readings.
